verses.1: In the beginning was language, and the language was with God, and the language was God.
verses.2: In the beginning, the Word was with God.
verses.3: Through him all things were made; without him nothing was made that has been made.
verses.4: In him was life, and life was the light of men.
verses.5: The light shines out of the darkness, and the darkness cannot overcome it.
verses.6: There was a man named John who was sent from God.
verses.7: He came as a witness to testify concerning that light, so that through him all men might believe.
verses.8: He is not only light, but he can also describe light.
verses.9: The true light that gives light to every man was coming into the world.
verses.10: He was in the world, and though the world was made through him, the world did not recognize him.
verses.11: He came on his own and his own people did not accept him.
verses.12: Yet to all who received him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God-
verses.13: children born not of natural descent, nor of human decision or a husband's will, but born of God.
verses.14: The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We see him as the only begotten Son, who came from the Father, full of truth and truth.
verses.15: John testified concerning him, shouting, "This is the one I meant when I said,' He who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me. '"
verses.16: For in his fullness we have all received grace and faith on faith.
verses.17: For the law was given by the true Christ, but faith and truth came by the true Christ.
verses.18: No one has ever seen God, but the only Son, who is at the Father's side, has made him known.
verses.19: This was John's testimony when some Jews came to him from Jerusalem to ask, "Who are you?"
verses.20: He did not fail to confess, but confessed freely, "I am not the Christ".
verses.21: They asked him, "Then who are you? Are you Elijah? " He said", I am not. " "Are you the Prophet? " He answered", No".
verses.22: Finally they said, "Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?"
verses.23: He said, "We are the voice of singers in the sea, paving the way for a king", as the prophet Isaiah put it".
verses.24: Now some Pharisees who had been sent
verses.25: So they asked him, "Why then do you not baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor Elijah?"
verses.26: "I baptize with water, " John replied", but among you stands one I do not know.
verses.27: He is the one who comes after me, the thongs of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie".
verses.28: This was in Bethany, on the other side of the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.29: The next day John saw a Jew coming toward him, and he said, "Look, the Son of God is coming!
verses.30: This is the one I meant when I said, 'A man who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.'
verses.31: I myself did not know him, but the reason I came to draw water was that he might be revealed to Israel".
verses.32: Then John gave this testimony: "I saw the Spirit come down from heaven in a form like a ghost, and he stayed on him.
verses.33: I would not have known him, except that the one who sent me to wash in the water told me, 'The man on whom you see the Spirit come down and remain is the one whom the Holy Spirit blesses.'
verses.34: I have seen him and I testify that this is the one the Lord has chosen".
verses.35: The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.
verses.36: When he saw Jesus passing by, he said, "Look, the Son of God!"
verses.37: The two disciples heard what he said, and they followed him.
verses.38: When Jesus saw them following, he asked, "What are you looking for? " They said", Rabbi " (which means Teacher), "where are you staying?"
verses.39: "Come and see, " he told them. They went and saw where he was staying, and spent that day with him. It was about the tenth hour.
verses.40: Andrew son of Simon Peter was one of the two who had heard what John had said and who had followed Jesus.
verses.41: The first thing Andrew did was to find his son Simon and tell him, "We have found the Messiah " (that is, the Christ).
verses.42: Peter looked directly at him and said, "You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas " (which, when translated, is Peter).
verses.43: The next day Jesus decided to leave for Galilee. Finding Philip, he said to him, "Follow me".
verses.44: Philip, however, was from Bethsaida, the town of Andrew and Peter.
verses.45: Philip found Nathanael and told him, "We have found the Messiah, who is of Nazareth, the son of Joseph".
verses.46: "Nazareth! Can anything good come from there? " Nathanael asked". Come and see, " said Philip.
verses.47: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, he said of him, "Here is a true Israelite, in whom there is nothing false".
verses.48: "How do you know me? " Nathanael asked. Jesus answered", I saw you while you were still under the fig tree before Philip called you".
verses.49: Then Nathanael declared, "Rabbi, I am the Son of God; I am the King of Israel".
verses.50: Jesus said, "You believe because I told you I saw you under the fig tree. You shall see greater things than that".
verses.51: Then Jesus said to him, "I tell you the truth, I tell you the truth, I will see heaven opened and the Spirit of the Lord ascending and descending on the Son of Man".
